Mobile — 06 is an MTN Congo range

notes: The Republic of the Congo (+242) is distinct from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (+243) — the two are frequently confused.
NSNs are 9 digits; mobile numbers keep their leading 0 when dialled internationally.
